Memory/HBM & Storage is the clear attention leader (score 3.83 vs 1.85 second) but is crowded and mean-reverting; the only validated edge on this market is absolute-trend gating, which is on. Given dir_accuracy 0.48 on 54 calls, directional conviction must stay low.
emerging_watch: Watching whether the precious-metals complex (Gold Miners + Silver Miners, ranks 2-3) strings together enough consecutive up days to move past the crowded memory-storage leader in durability-adjusted momentum; the condition that retires this watch is Memory/HBM's score falling below Silver Miners' score on a subsequent detector print.

theses.subject: Gold Miners
theses.thesis: Gold Miners shows the strongest trend-health profile in the top ranks: durable (0.73 bar), breadth 0.917, hurst_tag 'trend', uncrowded (z 0.22), and eligible. Unlike the mean-reverting leader, this leg aligns with the one validated edge — staying-power via the absolute-trend gate. The lean is a directional preference for trend persistence, not a claim of superior return.
theses.dissent: Precious metals miners can underperform on a rising-real-yields or risk-on rotation; the macro backdrop is dominated by geopolitics with 88% unscheduled surprise share, which cuts both ways for gold.

falsifier.text: GDX breaks below its 50-day moving average and stays there for 5 consecutive sessions before the check-by date.

theses.subject: Memory, HBM & Storage
theses.thesis: Memory/HBM is the unambiguous attention leader (score 3.83, nearly 2x the challenger) and is eligible. The lean is overweight only as a trend-following preference — NOT a buy because it leads. Crowding flag (z 1.44, crowded true) and hurst 'mean-revert' with breadth 0.0 are size-down cautions, not fade triggers. Durability bar is low (0.44), so the staying-power leg is weak.
theses.dissent: The combination of crowded positioning, zero breadth, and mean-reverting character makes this the most fragile leader in the top-5; an attention spike with no participation often marks the late stage of a theme, not its start.

falsifier.text: SMH lags the S&P 500 by 5% over a 10-trading-day window before the check-by date.

theses.subject: Silver Miners
theses.thesis: Silver Miners is the highest-scoring challenger (1.85) with strong breadth (0.75), decent durability (0.63), and is uncrowded (z 0.53). It pairs the same trend-health logic as Gold Miners with slightly more momentum. The lean is a modest directional preference for trend persistence in the precious-metals complex.
theses.dissent: Silver miners have higher industrial-beta than gold miners and can underperform if a slowdown narrative hits industrial demand; hurst 'mixed' suggests persistence is less reliable than gold's clean 'trend' tag.

falsifier.text: SIL gives back its relative gain vs GDX and trades below its 20-day moving average for 10 consecutive sessions before the check-by date.

macro_narrative.note: market-level macro/policy/geo narrative flow; coincident, not per-theme, never a trigger
